description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing LoanAmortizationAllocationMapping entities, including custom queries for retrieving and calculating amortization mappings connected to loan transactions.

classes.name: LoanAmortizationAllocationMappingRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for LoanAmortizationAllocationMapping entities, providing custom methods for querying amortization data related to loans.

methods.name: findAmortizationMappingsByBaseTransactionAndLoan
methods.description: Fetches a list of AmortizationAllocationMappingDTOs for a specific base loan transaction and loan ID, ordered by date.

methods.name: calculateAlreadyAmortizedAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total amortized amount for a particular base loan transaction and loan, considering the amortization type logic.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionAllocationByAmortizationLoanTransactionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanAmortizationAllocationMapping entities associated with a specific amortization loan transaction ID and loan ID.

calls: JOIN LoanTransaction at ON laam.amortizationLoanTransactionId = at.id
